result.reason: The clause adds workmanlike-performance, documentation-conformance, no-malicious-code, and repair/replace/refund concepts, but it includes no warranty period, so it reaches neither the preferred nor fallback duration. It also omits the required compliance-with-laws warranty. The remedy is ambiguously framed as applying to “this warranty,” and “refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming period” may not provide a workable refund for all covered breaches. In addition, the retained statement that Licensor does not warrant that documentation nonconformities can or will be corrected creates tension with the express conformance warranty and repair remedy. The redline otherwise largely preserves the original disclaimer and unrelated commercial allocation.
